thread:
Alex (Content): Quick pulse 0 min interview with HelioForge wrapped. Raw audio + rough cut in Drive: https://redwood.app/drive/helioforge. Marked hero clip 00:35-01:25. Need a final hero quote, legal redlines, and CRM routing before we publish.

Rina (PMM): Nice. Paste the hero one-liner you want on the landing. Also recommend we plan a webinar ~2 weeks after publish.

Maya (Producer): Uploaded the cuts. We can do a 60s hero + 30s social clip. Need final quote by Friday COB to keep the 3/18 publish.

Owen (AE): HelioForge asks that demo leads from the case page go to their Solutions Ops first, then fallback to our enterprise SDRs after 24h. They want campaign=helio_launch_0326 and a tracking token.

crm-bot: To add routing, provide comma-separated key=value pairs. Example: lead_source=case_study,owner=team-x.

Owen (AE): Use: lead_source=helioforge_case,owner=helio-solops,fallback_owner=redwood-enterprise-sdr,followup_delay=24h,campaign=helio_launch_0326,token=helio_tok_0326

Tara (Legal): I skimmed the transcript. Two asks: 1) They mentioned "4x inference cost reduction" 016021 022 (we need to redact any numeric multipliers unless HelioForge confirms in writing). Replace with "dramatic cost reduction" or similar. 2) Remove one competitor/vendor name. Send the edited quote and I'll sign off quickly.

Alex (Content): Proposed edited hero quote: "Redwood delivered dramatic cost reduction for inference and let our teams ship features faster."

Rina (PMM): Slight cadence tweak: "Redwood delivered dramatic inference cost reductions and helped our teams ship features faster."

Tara (Legal): That edit is fine. Approving with vendor redacted. Tara (Legal) :white_check_mark:

Maya (Producer): Copy that. I'll slot the approved quote into the landing draft and hand over the clips to design. Alex, can you confirm attribution and a 10-word bio for the byline?

Alex (Content): Attribution: "Dev Sen, VP of ML, HelioForge". Bio: "Leads ML platform and production inference at HelioForge."

Owen (AE): Confirming the CRM payload above. Also HelioForge requested the HubSpot ticket subject set to: "HelioForge case - demo request". Can we include that?

crm-bot: Routing rule queued to staging with ticket_subject=HelioForge case - demo request. Reminder: deploy to production 60 minutes before publish.

Rina (PMM): Webinar plan: target 2026-03-31 for a 30min customer demo + 15 Q&A. We'll promote the webinar on the case page and social. Maya, please draft speaker bullets and request headshot.

Maya (Producer): On it. Requesting headshot + signed quote consent from Dev. Will produce 60s hero cut + 30s social.

Tara (Legal): Once the landing has the edited quote and vendor redaction applied, ping me for final quick pass.

Alex (Content): Thanks all. Closing loop: quote edited and approved by Legal, routing queued to staging with tracking token and ticket subject, producer working on assets. I'll post the final landing copy tomorrow morning and tag for a final review. :rocket:
